title: Compact trace-map and token-cost heatmap for Observability quickstart
creator: Maya Chen
description: Design and export a compact set of visual assets for the Observability quickstart. Deliverables include: 1) a compact ‘trace-map’ screenshot that highlights end-to-end span relationships for a typical text-generation request, annotated with latency hotspots; 2) a token-cost heatmap screenshot (cost per token by model variant and sequence length) with lightweight legend and hover-callout copy for the docs; 3) small-format variants (600px wide) optimized for quickstart step-by-step copy; 4) high-resolution exports for release notes and marketing; and 5) an annotated overlay PSD/Figma file with callouts for engineering instrumentation links and tooltip copy. The goal is assets that are readable in the docs quickstart card, in the Console product tour, and as part of the rollout email. Focus on clarity for engineering audiences: exact numbers, percent delta callouts, and a compact color palette that maps to existing Console themes.
acceptance_criteria: Trace-map PNG exported at 1200px and 600px with annotations matching engineering telemetry (latency values and span names)
Token-cost heatmap exported in PNG and SVG with legend and two sample model rows (small, medium) and sequence length columns (16, 64, 256)
All assets have accessible color contrast and include a monochrome fallback for PDF/print
Figma source file shared with engineering and PM with comment threads resolved
Assets uploaded to the docs assets folder and referenced in the quickstart doc PR
